landing.faq_subtitle: Everything people ask us before getting started.
landing.final_cta_desc: Add your list now. It's free and we don't ask for a card or an account to start.

faq_home.a: Yes. You can organize draws of up to 15 participants with email and WhatsApp notifications without paying anything. The Premium plan exists for large groups and extra features, but the basic draw is free and you can run it as many times as you want.

faq_home.q: Do I have to sign up to try it?
faq_home.a: No. You can add your list and set the rules without creating an account: it's saved in your browser. We only ask you to sign in when you run the draw, so we can send the notifications and store the result.

faq_home.q: Can the organizer take part in the draw?
faq_home.a: Yes, and it's one of the main reasons to use the tool. Results are never shown on screen: each participant gets their own secret link, so whoever organizes can play without seeing anyone else's match.

faq_home.q: Can I stop two people from being matched?
faq_home.a: Yes. In the participant list you can set exclusions: for example, so a couple doesn't get each other, or so last year's match isn't repeated. The algorithm retries until it finds a combination that respects every rule.
Automatically by email and, if you added their phone number, by WhatsApp. You can also copy each person's secret link and send it yourself through any channel you like.

faq_home.q: What happens with my friends' data?
faq_home.a: We only use names, emails and phone numbers to send the notifications for that draw. We don't sell data or use it for advertising, and you can ask us to delete it at any time.
